examples: Answer a waiting question from the yellow slide-out without losing your place in the agents list.
Swap from questions straight to swarm with one click on the rail.
how_to: The menu lives down the left sidebar's left edge, as the full menu or as a pinned icon rail; it is the only sidebar layout.
The menu is the rail: agents is the top row, swarm is under it, and settings is the last row, with the pin at the bottom right of the sidebar.

Unpinned, hover the thin handle on the sidebar's left edge and the full menu slides out; move away and it goes back (escape from anywhere but a terminal puts it back too, and a swarm or questions panel that was open is swapped for the menu while you hover).

Pinned (click the pin at the bottom right of the sidebar, or the pin at the bottom of the rail), the menu becomes a narrow rail of icons, one per menu row. Hover an icon and its full name shows to the right while the icons grow like a dock; nothing animates while the pointer is away, and with reduced motion the names still show and nothing grows.
Click an icon to slide its panel over the agents list; click it again, the agents icon, the x, or press escape to go back to agents.
The menu closes when you pick a destination or click outside it; questions and swarm stay open while you work.
With the drawer collapsed, the same keys show in the narrow rail; pressing one opens the drawer on that panel.
Right-click the icon at the top left of an open panel's title row (or press shift+f10 on it) for that widget's menu: edit layout and whatever the widget offers.
Plugin page tabs such as flow get an icon too, once the tab is on; a closable one has a small x on its icon, or press delete on it.
From the keyboard, tab to the rail once, then use the arrow keys, home and end to move between icons and enter or space to open one.
Right-click the rail or its handle (or press shift+f10 on the handle) for its menu: pin rail, edit layout or done editing.
